records.title: The Myths of Mexico & Peru
records.translator: not applicable; authored in English by Lewis Spence
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: An early twentieth-century English synthesis covering multiple Mexican, Maya, and Peruvian traditions. It summarizes and cites older colonial-era sources; it is not a primary-source translation and must not be used to flatten distinct peoples.
